title: Automatic pin_old_readme_baseline() at push() PUSHED transition

evidence_refs: Independent adversarial review completed: /code-review high, 8 parallel finder agents (simplification, reuse, efficiency, angle-A diff, angle-B removed-behavior, altitude, conventions, angle-C cross-file) -- did not author the implementation

6 real findings from that review fixed in the same execution cycle and re-verified: OSError-escape past a durable PUSHED transition; corrupt-sidecar misclassified as manual pin; non-atomic sidecar write; CLI double-print of indeterminate products as DIRTY; discarded auto-pin result; and the most consequential -- font/python's historical mirror receipt vs a fresh live reclassification reading canonical, fixed via _ever_receipted_as_mirror()
1 real, deeper finding (compose-time drift, broader than push-time) deliberately deferred, not silently dropped -- filed as backlog ST-183
Final verification: pytest scripts/pipeline/tests/test_readme_refresh_run.py -q -> 214 passed, 0 failed, 0 regressions against the 195-test pre-mission baseline

Real-world validation: audit-baseline-coverage run against the live 32-product portfolio; tex/python and 3d/python reviewed (real push receipts confirmed canonical) and backfilled for real; post-backfill audit-portfolio proof for both (see EVIDENCE.md); font/python correctly left unresolved (mirror risk, human decision required)
Full evidence bundle: reports/plan_state/readme-refresh-audit-baseline-pinning-hardening-2026-09-03/EVIDENCE.md
